data.name: ApplicationNameInvalid
data.value: Application name is invalid. Use an RFC1123 label containing 1-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or '-' characters, beginning and ending with a letter or number.

data.name: ApplicationNameRequired
data.value: An RFC1123 application name is required. Pass it to Application.CreateBuilder(ApplicationName, args) or call UseName(...) before Build(); only unnamed Local builders use the entry-assembly fallback.

data.name: ApplicationCredentialSchemeInvalid
data.value: The application credential scheme must be a nonempty HTTP authentication token.

data.name: ApplicationCredentialValueInvalid
data.value: The application credential value must be nonblank and contain no carriage return or line feed.

data.name: ResourceHttpPathInvalid
data.value: A resource HTTP path must begin with '/' and contain no query or fragment.

data.name: ResourceMountSourceInvalid
data.value: A mount source must use parameter:<name>, literal:<value>, or <source>:<key>, with nonblank names and keys.

data.name: VolumeMountSourceInvalid
data.value: Volume mount '{0}' cannot declare Source.

data.name: LiteralMountKindInvalid
data.value: Mount '{0}' uses literal:, which is allowed only for Configuration mounts.

data.name: ProviderMountSourceInvalid
data.value: Resource '{0}' mount '{1}' source must use parameter:<name>, literal:<value>, or <source>:<key>.

data.name: ApplicationNameJsonString
data.value: An application name must be a JSON string.

data.name: ResourceRuntimeObjectRequired
data.value: A resource runtime manifest must be a JSON object when present.

data.name: TrustedIssuerKeyObjectRequired
data.value: A trusted issuer key must be a JSON object.

data.name: TrustedIssuerKeyMemberInvalid
data.value: A trusted issuer key contains unsupported or duplicate member '{0}'.

data.name: TrustedIssuerSigningKeyRequired
data.value: A trusted issuer key must be an EC P-256 key for ES256 signatures.

data.name: TrustedIssuerCoordinatesEncoding
data.value: A trusted issuer key has invalid base64url coordinates.

data.name: TrustedIssuerCoordinatesLength
data.value: A trusted issuer P-256 key must have 32-byte coordinates.

data.name: TrustedIssuerCurvePointInvalid
data.value: A trusted issuer key has coordinates that are not a valid P-256 point.

data.name: TrustedIssuerThumbprintMismatch
data.value: A trusted issuer key identifier must equal its RFC 7638 thumbprint.

data.name: TrustedIssuerKeyMemberRequired
data.value: A trusted issuer key requires string member '{0}'.

data.name: ResourceManifestSchemaUnsupported
data.value: Resource manifest schema '{0}' is not supported. Expected '{1}'.

data.name: ResourceManifestV2BuildStateUnsupported
data.value: Resource/v2 manifests contain deployment bindings only. State catalogs and initial values are supplied by the running resource.

data.name: ResourceGroupNameInvalid
data.value: A resource group name must contain one to 128 ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, or hyphens, and cannot be '.' or '..'.

data.name: ResourceGroupMembersInvalid
data.value: Resource group members must have nonempty, unique resource names.

data.name: ResourceGroupNested
data.value: Resource groups are flat logical containers and cannot be nested.

data.name: ResourceGroupDuplicate
data.value: Resource group '{0}' is already declared.

data.name: ResourceGroupMembershipInvalid
data.value: Logical resource groups contain an invalid name, duplicate group, unknown member, duplicate membership, or inconsistent descriptor and plan membership.
